## Change

Describe the problem and the behaviour this PR changes. Link the related issue, and its task number for milestone task work.

For milestone work, target the branch in [Milestone delivery](https://github.com/athrael-soju/Narwhal/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#milestone-delivery).

## Checks

List the checks you ran, their results, live fleet checks, and pending checks.

Keep hardware/model selections and raw evidence in private execution records. Include a sanitized evidence reference when applicable.

## Review context

For a bug fix, include reproduction steps. Remove credentials, live addresses, private paths, and hardware/model identifiers from attached logs or configuration.
